# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Complex Seamless

We can’t simplify clinical development – but we can execute it seamlessly

[Tell us about your upcoming project][111]
[organic growth icon] Quality At
Our Core

## Quality at our core

### Built to execute – enabled by organic growth

Accelerate your clinical development by partnering with a CRO that is structured to keep study teams
focused on execution. This commitment to quality extends to the projects we engage in – we are
selective to ensure we deliver the highest levels of service and partnering. Our unique approach has
been preserved by 30+ years of organic growth – delivering consistency and stability while avoiding
the disruptions associated with mergers and acquisitions.

[Learn More][112]
[integrated efficiency icon] Team
Continuity

## Team Continuity

### Expertise embedded in trials – throughout the project lifecycle

Engage with one cross-functional team that actively participates in your trial or program – from
early planning through close-out. Our approach maintains continuity and optimizes performance while
building strong team chemistry, minimizing disruptions, and ensuring high-quality results across our
full breadth of services. With deep scientific and therapeutic expertise, our teams are poised to
lead the industry’s most innovative and challenging clinical trials.

[Learn More][113]
[therapeutic focus icon] Integrated
Services

## Integrated Services

### End-to-end partnership – a model of productivity

Streamline even the most complex clinical trials with a full-service, single-vendor outsourcing
strategy. Our comprehensive CRO services are supported by our wholly-owned Central Laboratories,
Bioanalytical Lab, Imaging Core Lab, ECG Core Lab, and Phase I Unit, as well as a Clinical Trial
Management System that ties all study data together in a single platform. With integrated services
and systems, we achieve higher levels of efficiency and productivity.

[Learn More][114]
[global reach icon] Global
Engagement

## GLOBAL Engagement

### Navigating cultures and requirements – reaching patients around the world

Leverage our country-specific experience and breadth of in-house expertise to navigate languages,
cultures, and clinical and regulatory environments around the globe. Our resources extend across
North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific with strong site and Investigator
relationships to reach targeted and diverse patient populations. Our global reach and experience
across all phases of development and key therapeutic areas can help streamline your clinical trials
and reach your development goals faster.

The Medpace Advantage

## A Full-Service Model for Quality and Efficiency

Driven by a full-service CRO model that coordinates and integrates all services for our clients,
Medpace provides an accountable, seamless, integrated, and efficient platform for executing clinical
research – increasing quality and speed while significantly reducing the need for duplicate
management oversight. More than a “set of extra hands”, we are an extension of your team – embedding
medical, regulatory, and operational expertise into your trials to navigate and overcome challenges.
It’s how we make the complex seamless. And it’s why we are **Trusted by Biotech^{®}**.

[Full-Service Model][116]
[See Why Medpace is Trusted by Biotech][117]

Therapeutic Areas

## Embedded Therapeutic Expertise

Medpace employs a high-science and disciplined operating approach that leverages regulatory and
therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas. For sponsors, this means your clinical
trial will be led by a collaborative team of medical, operational, and regulatory experts with deep
knowledge and insights about the disease and the patients your clinical trial is targeting. Backed
by over 30 years of experience, our relationships with Key Opinion Leaders, Principal Investigators,
and high-performing sites help accelerate clinical development. 

[Explore Our Therapeutic Areas][118]

CRO Capabilities

## Our One Team Approach

When you partner with Medpace, you get guidance from our cross-functional team of experts who work
together—combining our experience and perspectives—to guide and accelerate your compound through
clinical development. This “cross-pollination” of experts from numerous functional areas—including
medical, regulatory, operations, labs, and imaging—allows us to apply our experience and
relationships to an extensive range of diseases. As a full-service CRO with labs, imaging, a phase I
unit, and cardiac safety capabilities, we offer comprehensive services and the support of our
collective expertise to accelerate your studies and programs.

[Explore Our CRO Services][119]
[Medpace scientist in the lab]

## Fully Integrated for Efficiency 

Because almost every clinical trial requires laboratory support, having wholly-owned entities with a
broad range of capabilities and comprehensive test menus provides built-in efficiencies and
collaboration. In concert with the Medpace CRO or working on standalone projects, experts from our
central laboratories and bioanalytical laboratory can help plan and execute your testing needs.

# Making the Complex Seamless

We can’t simplify clinical development – but we can execute it seamlessly

[Tell us about your upcoming project][111]
[organic growth icon] Quality At
Our Core

## Quality at our core

### Built to execute – enabled by organic growth

Accelerate your clinical development by partnering with a CRO that is structured to keep study teams
focused on execution. This commitment to quality extends to the projects we engage in – we are
selective to ensure we deliver the highest levels of service and partnering. Our unique approach has
been preserved by 30+ years of organic growth – delivering consistency and stability while avoiding
the disruptions associated with mergers and acquisitions.

[Learn More][112]
[integrated efficiency icon] Team
Continuity

## Team Continuity

### Expertise embedded in trials – throughout the project lifecycle

Engage with one cross-functional team that actively participates in your trial or program – from
early planning through close-out. Our approach maintains continuity and optimizes performance while
building strong team chemistry, minimizing disruptions, and ensuring high-quality results across our
full breadth of services. With deep scientific and therapeutic expertise, our teams are poised to
lead the industry’s most innovative and challenging clinical trials.

[Learn More][113]
[therapeutic focus icon] Integrated
Services

## Integrated Services

### End-to-end partnership – a model of productivity

Streamline even the most complex clinical trials with a full-service, single-vendor outsourcing
strategy. Our comprehensive CRO services are supported by our wholly-owned Central Laboratories,
Bioanalytical Lab, Imaging Core Lab, ECG Core Lab, and Phase I Unit, as well as a Clinical Trial
Management System that ties all study data together in a single platform. With integrated services
and systems, we achieve higher levels of efficiency and productivity.

[Learn More][114]
[global reach icon] Global
Engagement

## GLOBAL Engagement

### Navigating cultures and requirements – reaching patients around the world

Leverage our country-specific experience and breadth of in-house expertise to navigate languages,
cultures, and clinical and regulatory environments around the globe. Our resources extend across
North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific with strong site and Investigator
relationships to reach targeted and diverse patient populations. Our global reach and experience
across all phases of development and key therapeutic areas can help streamline your clinical trials
and reach your development goals faster.

[Learn More][115]

The Medpace Advantage

## A Full-Service Model for Quality and Efficiency

Driven by a full-service CRO model that coordinates and integrates all services for our clients,
Medpace provides an accountable, seamless, integrated, and efficient platform for executing clinical
research – increasing quality and speed while significantly reducing the need for duplicate
management oversight. More than a “set of extra hands”, we are an extension of your team – embedding
medical, regulatory, and operational expertise into your trials to navigate and overcome challenges.
It’s how we make the complex seamless. And it’s why we are **Trusted by Biotech^{®}**.

[Full-Service Model][116]
[See Why Medpace is Trusted by Biotech][117]

Therapeutic Areas

## Embedded Therapeutic Expertise

Medpace employs a high-science and disciplined operating approach that leverages regulatory and
therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas. For sponsors, this means your clinical
trial will be led by a collaborative team of medical, operational, and regulatory experts with deep
knowledge and insights about the disease and the patients your clinical trial is targeting. Backed
by over 30 years of experience, our relationships with Key Opinion Leaders, Principal Investigators,
and high-performing sites help accelerate clinical development. 

[Explore Our Therapeutic Areas][118]

CRO Capabilities

## Our One Team Approach

When you partner with Medpace, you get guidance from our cross-functional team of experts who work
together—combining our experience and perspectives—to guide and accelerate your compound through
clinical development. This “cross-pollination” of experts from numerous functional areas—including
medical, regulatory, operations, labs, and imaging—allows us to apply our experience and
relationships to an extensive range of diseases. As a full-service CRO with labs, imaging, a phase I
unit, and cardiac safety capabilities, we offer comprehensive services and the support of our
collective expertise to accelerate your studies and programs.

[Explore Our CRO Services][119]
[Medpace scientist in the lab]

## Fully Integrated for Efficiency 

Because almost every clinical trial requires laboratory support, having wholly-owned entities with a
broad range of capabilities and comprehensive test menus provides built-in efficiencies and
collaboration. In concert with the Medpace CRO or working on standalone projects, experts from our
central laboratories and bioanalytical laboratory can help plan and execute your testing needs.

CryoText™ is our most concentrated, non-coded Wharton's Jelly or human umbilical cord product that
is rich in cytokines, growth factors and scaffolding proteins. It acts as a replacement tissue that
is intended to replace missing or damaged connective tissue.

### SECRETEXT™

SecreText™ is our newest dose form of Wharton's Jelly intended for smaller defects. Its tissue size
is best suited for aesthetic applications where volume is needed to cushion or support the affected
area.

### PROTEXT™

ProText™ is our most concentrated Wharton's Jelly connective tissue supplement. It is intended for
homologous use only to replace or supplement missing or damaged tissue directly at the site of the
structural defect.

AmnioText™ is a sterile, dehydrated human amniotic membrane allograft, intended for homologous use
to cover and protect the recipient's tissues.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market

reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids
## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

We applaud Congress for passing ARM’s top two legislative priorities and are grateful to our partner
organizations whose collaboration and advocacy were crucial in securing the necessary support.

[ Read ARM's Statement ][121]
[ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids Access
to Care Act]

scientific engagement. Together, we have the power to advance the sector and improve patients'
lives.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody

debilitating diseases.

## Popular in the [FAQ][46]

What is Audacity?

Audacity is the world’s most popular free software for recording and editing audio. So if you're
producing music, a podcast, or just playing around with audio, Audacity is for you.

Who is Audacity for?

Audacity is for anyone who wants to get creative with sound. It’s also the perfect tool for anyone
who needs to quickly edit or export audio, for any reason.

Is Audacity free?

Yes! Audacity has always been and will always remain free for everyone.

Is Audacity open source?

Audacity is proudly open source. This means its source code remains open to anyone to view or
modify.
A dedicated worldwide community of passionate audio lovers have collaborated to make Audacity the
well-loved software it is today. Many third-party plugins have also been developed for Audacity
thanks to its open source nature.

Audacity

Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and
other operating systems. Audacity is free, open source software.

## Popular in the [FAQ][46]

What is Audacity?

Audacity is the world’s most popular free software for recording and editing audio. So if you're
producing music, a podcast, or just playing around with audio, Audacity is for you.

Who is Audacity for?

Audacity is for anyone who wants to get creative with sound. It’s also the perfect tool for anyone
who needs to quickly edit or export audio, for any reason.

Is Audacity free?

Yes! Audacity has always been and will always remain free for everyone.

Is Audacity open source?

Audacity is proudly open source. This means its source code remains open to anyone to view or
modify.
A dedicated worldwide community of passionate audio lovers have collaborated to make Audacity the
well-loved software it is today. Many third-party plugins have also been developed for Audacity
thanks to its open source nature.

Audacity

Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and
other operating systems. Audacity is free, open source software.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

# You deserve the world’s leading stem cell therapy and research center.

For 20 years, Stem Cell Institute has been a **global leader** in stem cell research and treatment.
Our established history, advanced science, and personalized treatments help provide you with the
best opportunities for **optimal health**.

With a team of renowned experts and a** state-of-the-art facility **in Panama City, Panama, we offer
the** highest quality stem cell therapy** for chronic conditions, injuries, and general wellness
that has transformed the lives of thousands of patients worldwide.

## Stem Cells Like No Other: Golden Cells™

After two decades of research and years of treating thousands of patients, our team made our best
discovery yet—Golden Cells™. These specially selected human umbilical cord tissue-derived allogeneic
mesenchymal stem cells (hUCT-MSCs) originate from six cell lines found during a retrospective
analysis of our highly successful cases. They are now the foundation of our stem cell treatments to
provide patients with the best opportunities for optimal outcomes. 

**Exclusive to Stem Cell Institute—Golden Cells™ are not available at any other stem cell clinic
worldwide.**

[ Learn More ][13]

doctors will craft your personalized treatment plan.

Our patient care team and concierge will help arrange your exceptional stay in Panama City, Panama
and stem cell treatments with our proprietary Golden Cells™.

After treatment, our team will follow up with you regularly to monitor your progress, answer
questions, and provide support on
your health journey.

derived from umbilical cord donations of healthy, full-term births. Collected in a sterile

Riordan’s state-of-the-art stem cell lab, Medistem Panama.

lab with over 75 employees, 15 of whom are specialists dedicated solely to quality control. It is
licensed to collect, isolate, process, grow, and store a variety of stem cells, including our unique
Golden Cells™.

we only deliver the highest quality during treatment.**

## You probably have questions. We’re here to help.

What makes Stem Cell Institute different from other stem cell clinics?

Our approach to stem cell therapy is distinguished by four key factors:

1.** Experience:** With 20 years of experience and more than 80,000 procedures delivered to
patients, we are proud to be the world’s leading stem cell therapy and research center.

2.** Innovative Technology:** Our Research team and Doctors have spent years developing our own
proprietary technology. This includes our unique [Golden Cells™][61], which are identified and
expanded using advanced screening techniques to provide the best opportunities for optimal outcomes.
Golden Cells™ are proprietary to Stem Cell Institute Panama. You won’t find them at any other stem
cell clinic in the world!

3.** On-site Research and Processing:** All stem cells are processed at Medistem Panama, an 11,000
sq. ft, ISO 9001 certified, and GMP-compliant research and production lab with over 75 team members,
15 of whom are specialists dedicated solely to quality control. Also founded by [Neil Riordan, PA,
PhD][62], Medistem Panama allows us to control the entire process of producing safe, high-quality
stem cells before administering them to our patients.

4.** Quality over Quantity: **We place a strong emphasis on the quality and viability of the stem
cells we use, not just the quantity. While some clinics may focus on offering large numbers of
cells, what truly matters is the therapeutic potential of each cell. Our rigorous selection and
processing ensures that only potent, high-quality Golden Cells™ are administered to Stem Cell
Institute patients.

What are Golden Cells™, and why are they important?

[Golden Cells™][63] are the exclusive mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) used in all treatments at Stem
Cell Institute Panama. Developed through years of research and a retrospective analysis of our
highly successful cases, these cells are identified and selected using proprietary technology that
evaluates their molecular signature to ensure only highly effective cells are chosen. 

*“This is the first time in history that anyone has been able to retrospectively analyze which MSCs
have more benefit. I like to say that an MSC is not an MSC… Some perform better than others. That’s
why we’ve been working to select the best cells for use in patients with chronic disease. Now we can
retrospectively analyze existing data on outcomes. We are the only stem cell company with the data
to do that.”*

– [Neil Riordan, PA, PhD][64], Stem Cell Therapy: A Rising Tide: How Stem Cells Are Disrupting
Medicine and Transforming Lives

Among many other things, our Golden Cells™ are known to help:
* Reduce inflammation
  
   
* Modulate the immune system
  
   
* Secrete factors that may help various tissues throughout the body to regenerate

[Watch this video][65] to learn more about Golden Cells™ from our founder, Dr. Neil Riordan.

Are stem cells safe?

Stem cell treatments at the Stem Cell Institute are designed to meet the highest safety standards.
We use specially-selected mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) known as [Golden Cells™][66], which have
been extensively studied and are considered safe for therapeutic use. 

Our process is overseen by a team of 100+ professionals with 20 years of experience performing
55,000+ procedures safely. There have been no serious adverse effects of stem cell therapy reported
by the 15,000+ patients we have treated.

How are stem cells sourced for treatment?

The stem cells we use are specially-selected mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) derived from umbilical
cord donations of healthy, full-term births. 

The process of collecting and preparing these cells is meticulous:
* Cord donations are sourced exclusively from healthy women after normal, c-section births in Panama
  who willingly participate in our donation program.
  
   
* We only accept donations from families who have undergone thorough medical screening to ensure the
  absence of infections and other risks. Our donors sign a consent form, fill out a detailed
  questionnaire, and give a blood sample. The mothers’ blood undergoes extensive testing for a
  variety of infectious diseases in accordance with international blood bank guidelines.
* Umbilical cords are collected in a sterile environment immediately after delivery, posing no risk
  to the mother or baby.
* Once collected, the cords are immediately transported to Medistem Panama, Dr. Riordan’s local
  state-of-the-art stem cell laboratory, where the cells are isolated, tested, and prepared for use.

How are stem cells administered?

At Stem Cell Institute, our Golden Cells™ are administered in different ways depending on the
patient’s condition and specific needs. Typically, patients receive at least three rounds of stem
cell treatments as part of their overall care plan. These treatments can be administered through:
1. **Intravenous (IV)** – Stem cells are infused directly into the bloodstream.
   
    
2. **Intramuscular** – Stem cells are injected into the muscle tissue.
   
    
3. **Intrathecal** – Stem cells are injected into the spinal fluid to target the central nervous
   system.
   
    
4. **Perilymphatic** – Stem cells are injected around the lymph nodes.
   
    
5. **Intra-articular **– Stem cells are injected into joints using image guidance.

## You probably have questions. We’re here to help.

What makes Stem Cell Institute different from other stem cell clinics?

Our approach to stem cell therapy is distinguished by four key factors:

1.** Experience:** With 20 years of experience and more than 80,000 procedures delivered to
patients, we are proud to be the world’s leading stem cell therapy and research center.

2.** Innovative Technology:** Our Research team and Doctors have spent years developing our own
proprietary technology. This includes our unique [Golden Cells™][61], which are identified and
expanded using advanced screening techniques to provide the best opportunities for optimal outcomes.
Golden Cells™ are proprietary to Stem Cell Institute Panama. You won’t find them at any other stem
cell clinic in the world!

3.** On-site Research and Processing:** All stem cells are processed at Medistem Panama, an 11,000
sq. ft, ISO 9001 certified, and GMP-compliant research and production lab with over 75 team members,
15 of whom are specialists dedicated solely to quality control. Also founded by [Neil Riordan, PA,
PhD][62], Medistem Panama allows us to control the entire process of producing safe, high-quality
stem cells before administering them to our patients.

4.** Quality over Quantity: **We place a strong emphasis on the quality and viability of the stem
cells we use, not just the quantity. While some clinics may focus on offering large numbers of
cells, what truly matters is the therapeutic potential of each cell. Our rigorous selection and
processing ensures that only potent, high-quality Golden Cells™ are administered to Stem Cell
Institute patients.

What are Golden Cells™, and why are they important?

[Golden Cells™][63] are the exclusive mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) used in all treatments at Stem
Cell Institute Panama. Developed through years of research and a retrospective analysis of our
highly successful cases, these cells are identified and selected using proprietary technology that
evaluates their molecular signature to ensure only highly effective cells are chosen. 

*“This is the first time in history that anyone has been able to retrospectively analyze which MSCs
have more benefit. I like to say that an MSC is not an MSC… Some perform better than others. That’s
why we’ve been working to select the best cells for use in patients with chronic disease. Now we can
retrospectively analyze existing data on outcomes. We are the only stem cell company with the data
to do that.”*

– [Neil Riordan, PA, PhD][64], Stem Cell Therapy: A Rising Tide: How Stem Cells Are Disrupting
Medicine and Transforming Lives

Among many other things, our Golden Cells™ are known to help:
* Reduce inflammation
  
   
* Modulate the immune system
  
   
* Secrete factors that may help various tissues throughout the body to regenerate

[Watch this video][65] to learn more about Golden Cells™ from our founder, Dr. Neil Riordan.

Are stem cells safe?

Stem cell treatments at the Stem Cell Institute are designed to meet the highest safety standards.
We use specially-selected mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) known as [Golden Cells™][66], which have
been extensively studied and are considered safe for therapeutic use. 

Our process is overseen by a team of 100+ professionals with 20 years of experience performing
55,000+ procedures safely. There have been no serious adverse effects of stem cell therapy reported
by the 15,000+ patients we have treated.

How are stem cells sourced for treatment?

The stem cells we use are specially-selected mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) derived from umbilical
cord donations of healthy, full-term births. 

The process of collecting and preparing these cells is meticulous:
* Cord donations are sourced exclusively from healthy women after normal, c-section births in Panama
  who willingly participate in our donation program.
  
   
* We only accept donations from families who have undergone thorough medical screening to ensure the
  absence of infections and other risks. Our donors sign a consent form, fill out a detailed
  questionnaire, and give a blood sample. The mothers’ blood undergoes extensive testing for a
  variety of infectious diseases in accordance with international blood bank guidelines.
* Umbilical cords are collected in a sterile environment immediately after delivery, posing no risk
  to the mother or baby.
* Once collected, the cords are immediately transported to Medistem Panama, Dr. Riordan’s local
  state-of-the-art stem cell laboratory, where the cells are isolated, tested, and prepared for use.

How are stem cells administered?

At Stem Cell Institute, our Golden Cells™ are administered in different ways depending on the
patient’s condition and specific needs. Typically, patients receive at least three rounds of stem
cell treatments as part of their overall care plan. These treatments can be administered through:
1. **Intravenous (IV)** – Stem cells are infused directly into the bloodstream.
   
    
2. **Intramuscular** – Stem cells are injected into the muscle tissue.
   
    
3. **Intrathecal** – Stem cells are injected into the spinal fluid to target the central nervous
   system.
   
    
4. **Perilymphatic** – Stem cells are injected around the lymph nodes.
   
    
5. **Intra-articular **– Stem cells are injected into joints using image guidance.

Welcome to Cencora

# Find solutions that pave a reliable path to patients

Explore our full range of solutions designed to help you bring innovations to market and improve
care delivery worldwide.
[ Explore our solutions ][90]
[A light-skinned person wearing a white track jacket and a bright t-shirt jogging through a park
with the morning sun shining behind their head.]

## Distribution, commercialization, patient access, and pharmacy solutions for manufacturers,
## providers, and health systems.

We combine global capabilities and local expertise to help healthcare professionals bring
life-saving therapies, preventive treatments, and high-quality care to communities around the world.

[Logistics and warehousing][91] **

Leverage our global network to ensure safe, secure storage and timely delivery worldwide.

[ Drug research and clinical development support ][92] **

Streamline the drug development process and minimize go-to-market risk.

[ Commercialization support ][93] **

Build a foundation for a successful product launch and accelerate your speed-to-market.

[ Patient access and adherence support ][94] **

Address barriers to patient access and increase your product's speed-to-therapy.

[ Wholesale and specialty distribution ][95] **

Increase access to medications with our innovative solutions and secure supply chain.

[ Provider solutions ][96] **

Elevate the patient experience and expand care possibilities with physician practice solutions.

[ Pharmacy solutions ][97] **

Build and scale your pharmacy, accelerate growth, and deliver stronger clinical results.

[ Hospital and health system solutions ][98] **

Solve critical problems, plan for sustainable growth, and create better health outcomes.

[ Explore our capabilities ][99]

## Why Cencora

The end-to-end support we provide across the entire healthcare spectrum isn’t the only thing that
sets Cencora apart. There are so many other ways we provide a differentiated experience when you tap
into our unique capabilities.

### Global reach with local expertise

With a presence in over 50 countries, we’re expanding access to care worldwide, while our
community-level insight helps us to deploy resources effectively and efficiently.
[ Learn more about our global reach ][100]

### A commitment to innovation

Together with our industry partners, we’re continuously innovating to meet the needs of our
customers, evolving our solutions, and reshaping how healthcare is delivered.
[ Learn more about our innovation commitment ][101]

### A partner-centric  approach

We work closely with pharma companies and care providers every day, listening to their challenges
and using their insights to develop solutions that will have a positive impact on their patients.
[ Learn more about us ][102]

## What is Cencora?

It’s not easy to fully understand everything Cencora does. With countless solutions and services for
manufacturers, health systems, government entities, physician practices, pharmacies, and more, it’s
practically impossible for us to summarize what we offer without sacrificing some very important
details.

Watch this video to see some of our team members trying to define Cencora, and then check out our
stories to gain deeper insight into our business, our purpose, and our impact.
[ Explore all of our stories ][103]

The Pediatric Cell and Gene Therapy Research Center, established in 2016, is the first center in the

### Key Activities

The Pediatric Cell and Gene Therapy Research Center focuses on advancing cell and gene-based
therapies for children, conducting research, training specialists, and fostering international
collaborations. Key activities include supporting researchers, organizing scientific events, and
publishing papers to improve treatments for genetic diseases, chronic conditions, and cancer in
children. The center aims to enhance children’s health through innovative therapies and global
scientific collaboration.

][57] [

### Center's Mission

The Pediatric Cell and Gene Therapy Research Center advances children’s health through research,
development of cell and gene therapy knowledge, and improved healthcare services. It focuses on
creating a comprehensive data bank, training skilled personnel, and fostering scientific
collaborations to enhance treatments for genetic and chronic diseases in children

][58] [

### Collaboration with Us

The Pediatric Cell and Gene Therapy Research Center offers its expertise and resources to support
research in modern cell and gene therapies for children. It provides access to a comprehensive
genetic database, advanced equipment, and a specialized team to collaborate on research projects.
Areas of collaboration include immunotherapy for pediatric cancers, gene therapy for rare diseases,
and cell therapy for neurological and chronic disorders.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

  ### AI assistant enhances access to Investor Relations information
  
  Today, Fresenius has launched the AI-powered assistant – “AskFRE” – on its Investor Relations (IR)
  website, marking an important step in advancing its digital capital markets communications. The
  solution is a joint initiative of the Fresenius AI Center of Excellence and the Investor Relations
  team.With AskFRE, visitors can now interact with an integrated AI chatbot that provides direct
  answers to capital market-relevant information. This includes financial results, company updates
  and other IR content – based exclusively on publicly available Fresenius disclosures.In an
  increasingly fast-paced and data-driven environment, digital investor relations play a key role in
  delivering timely, transparent and stakeholder-focused communication. AskFRE supports this
  ambition by enabling more intuitive access to financial information and tailored user
  interactions, while reinforcing the consistency and accessibility of Fresenius’ disclosures.With
  AskFRE, Fresenius underscores its commitment to advancing a best in class digital investor
  relations experience.AskFRE is now available: https://www.fresenius.com/AskFRE-Your-IR-Assistant

* Brief News
  
  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.
  
   
  
  March 25, 2026 · Fresenius

* Brief News
  
  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.

# Live Life Healthier Longer™

At the Global Alliance for Regenerative Medicine (GARM), we’re dedicated to more than just helping
you live longer. Our mission is to help you enjoy more healthy, active, rewarding years.

## Transforming Health Through Regenerative Medicine

We specialize in a range of regenerative treatments designed to improve the length and quality of
your life. Our therapies include cutting-edge stem cell treatments for joint repair, injury
recovery, and chronic pain management, as well as innovative personalized protocols for advancing
longevity by addressing genetic disorders and enhancing cellular function. We are committed to
helping you enjoy more healthy years by offering personalized and advanced solutions tailored to
your specific health needs.

## Unlock The Healing Power Of Stem Cells

For over a decade, GARM has empowered patients to sidestep invasive surgeries and alleviate pain
through comprehensive musculoskeletal and spinal stem cell therapies. Our personalized regenerative
treatments are designed to address the root causes of discomfort, promote natural healing and
improve quality of life.

## The Personalized Protocol Revolution

At GARM Clinic, we believe that regenerative medicine isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our approach launches
with comprehensive diagnostics and physician-led design of a custom, multi-modal protocol rooted in
science, precision, and elite oversight. Whether you’re an executive seeking longevity, an athlete
in recovery, or someone frustrated by chronic degeneration, your plan is built for your unique
terrain—because you’re not average, and your care shouldn’t be either.

[Want to learn more?][90][Download our brochure][91]

Meticulously designed to enhance cellular health and promote overall rejuvenation, our comprehensive
program integrates advanced regenerative therapies, including stem cell treatments and other
advanced biologics, to address your unique wellness goals. We focus on revitalizing your body's
cellular functions to restore vitality, boost energy levels, and support a more youthful state of
well-being.

### Gene Therapy

Reverses epigenetic aging by up to 12 years, restoring cellular youth and vitality. Addresses aging
factors like obesity and inflammation to support a healthier, longer life.

### Exosome-Enhanced Cognitive Support

Eases oxidative stress and inflammation to protect neurons and support brain health. Promotes
regeneration and longevity with exosomes that repair cells and slow aging.

### Metabolic Optimization and Plasmapheresis

Supports detoxification and reduces oxidative stress with glutathione, while essential B vitamins
boost energy and vitality. Strengthens immunity, promotes cellular health, and fosters overall
rejuvenation for lasting wellness.

### Stem Cell: Aesthetics, Hair Restoration, Sexual Health

Harness the power of regenerative stem cells to rejuvenate skin and hair from within. This
innovative therapy promotes collagen production and elasticity, helping you look and feel your best
for the long term.

### **Regenerative Medicine**

Harnesses your body's natural healing potential to repair damaged tissues and address the root
causes of chronic conditions. These advanced cellular therapies promote tissue renewal, accelerate
recovery, and restore optimal function for lasting vitality.

Curated IV Therapies and advanced infusions that deliver targeted hydration, nutrients,
antioxidants, and regenerative biologic support

# Live Life Healthier Longer™

At the Global Alliance for Regenerative Medicine (GARM), we’re dedicated to more than just helping
you live longer. Our mission is to help you enjoy more healthy, active, rewarding years.

## Transforming Health Through Regenerative Medicine

We specialize in a range of regenerative treatments designed to improve the length and quality of
your life. Our therapies include cutting-edge stem cell treatments for joint repair, injury
recovery, and chronic pain management, as well as innovative personalized protocols for advancing
longevity by addressing genetic disorders and enhancing cellular function. We are committed to
helping you enjoy more healthy years by offering personalized and advanced solutions tailored to
your specific health needs.

## Unlock The Healing Power Of Stem Cells

For over a decade, GARM has empowered patients to sidestep invasive surgeries and alleviate pain
through comprehensive musculoskeletal and spinal stem cell therapies. Our personalized regenerative
treatments are designed to address the root causes of discomfort, promote natural healing and
improve quality of life.

## The Personalized Protocol Revolution

At GARM Clinic, we believe that regenerative medicine isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our approach launches
with comprehensive diagnostics and physician-led design of a custom, multi-modal protocol rooted in
science, precision, and elite oversight. Whether you’re an executive seeking longevity, an athlete
in recovery, or someone frustrated by chronic degeneration, your plan is built for your unique
terrain—because you’re not average, and your care shouldn’t be either.

[Want to learn more?][90][Download our brochure][91]

## The Ultimate Longevity Program:

### Multiple Remarkable Treatments To Help You Live Longer & Better

Meticulously designed to enhance cellular health and promote overall rejuvenation, our comprehensive
program integrates advanced regenerative therapies, including stem cell treatments and other
advanced biologics, to address your unique wellness goals. We focus on revitalizing your body's
cellular functions to restore vitality, boost energy levels, and support a more youthful state of
well-being.

### Gene Therapy

Reverses epigenetic aging by up to 12 years, restoring cellular youth and vitality. Addresses aging
factors like obesity and inflammation to support a healthier, longer life.

### Exosome-Enhanced Cognitive Support

Eases oxidative stress and inflammation to protect neurons and support brain health. Promotes
regeneration and longevity with exosomes that repair cells and slow aging.

### Metabolic Optimization and Plasmapheresis

Supports detoxification and reduces oxidative stress with glutathione, while essential B vitamins
boost energy and vitality. Strengthens immunity, promotes cellular health, and fosters overall
rejuvenation for lasting wellness.

### Stem Cell: Aesthetics, Hair Restoration, Sexual Health

Harness the power of regenerative stem cells to rejuvenate skin and hair from within. This
innovative therapy promotes collagen production and elasticity, helping you look and feel your best
for the long term.

### **Regenerative Medicine**

Harnesses your body's natural healing potential to repair damaged tissues and address the root
causes of chronic conditions. These advanced cellular therapies promote tissue renewal, accelerate
recovery, and restore optimal function for lasting vitality.

### **Advanced IV Therapies**

Curated IV Therapies and advanced infusions that deliver targeted hydration, nutrients,
antioxidants, and regenerative biologic support

Dr. Glenn C. Terry, M.D. is a U.S. Board Certified orthopedic surgeon, renowned as a pioneer in

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## The GMP+ Company database


Do you want to find GMP+ certified companies, Certification Bodies, laboratories, or partners? The

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

[Image]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.
