[
Contact Us
][45]
[Gold icon]

### Achieve Your Dream Look

## Personalized Cosmetic Enhancements Tailored for You

As we age, our bodies don't often reflect how we feel inside. At Ageless Cosmetic & Surgical Center,
we help turn back the clock with our cosmetic and medical aesthetic treatments in Long Island, NY
and surrounding areas, to improve our clients' confidence and help them achieve their ideal look.
Our team, led by Dr. Dreschnack and Dr. Domantovsky, is committed to helping you feel confident and
comfortable in your own skin.
[
Learn More
][46]
[Gold icon]

## Find the Right Treatment for You

[

### Hair Restoration / Hair Transplant

Regain your confidence with our advanced hair restoration techniques. We utilize proven methods to
stimulate natural growth and restore fullness to thinning areas.

### Hair Restoration / Hair Transplant

][47][

### Clearlift / Harmony

Rejuvenate your skin gently with the ClearLift and Harmony laser systems. Our non-invasive
treatments effectively reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and age spots.

### Clearlift / Harmony

][48][

### CoolSculpting® Elite

CoolSculpting® targets diet- and exercise-resistant fat pockets, freezes them, and eliminates them
to reveal a more sculpted physique.

### CoolSculpting® Elite

][49][

### BeautiFill™, Liposuction and Fat Transfer

Reshape your body by removing unwanted fat from one area and restoring lost volume in another, to
help you achieve your desired shape.

### BeautiFill™, Liposuction and Fat Transfer

][50][

### Laser Hair Removal

Say goodbye to the daily hassle of shaving and waxing. Our laser hair removal treatments offer a
safe, long-lasting solution for smooth skin across almost any area of the body.

### Laser Hair Removal

][51][

### Morpheus8 RF-MicroNeedling

Our non-invasive, highly effective skin rejuvenation treatment enhances your appearance without the
need for invasive surgery.

### Morpheus8 RF-MicroNeedling

][52][

### Beautifirm Skin Tightening & Endermologie Cellulite Removal

Combining BeautiFirm technology with Endermologie, we offer a highly effective method to reduce
cellulite and improve overall skin elasticity, creating a smoother appearance.

### Beautifirm Skin Tightening & Endermologie Cellulite Removal

][53][

### IPL

Intense Pulsed Light effectively treats sun damage, rosacea, and hyperpigmentation by delivering
targeted light energy to even out skin tone and reduce visible discoloration.

### IPL

][54][

### ClearSkin

Combat active acne and prevent future breakouts safely with ClearSkin laser treatment. Targeting the
root cause of acne while stimulating healthy tissue leaves you with clearer skin.

### ClearSkin

][55][

### Regenerative Health

Harnessing your body's innate healing capabilities to aid in healing, manage pain, and alleviate
numerous conditions.

### Regenerative Health

][56]

View All

## Take the Next Step Toward Your Aesthetic Goals

When you choose Ageless Cosmetic & Surgical Center for your cosmetic and medical aesthetics
treatments, you can feel confident in our ability to deliver stunning results that last. Our top
priority is to help our clients feel empowered by delivering treatments that go beyond appearance by
restoring confidence and enhancing their quality of life. Our safe, ethical, and personalized care
plans are meant to deliver beautiful results.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

#### Regenerative Therapy

Regenerative therapy is to help find solutions to treat injuries and diseases previously considered

#### Autologous Stem Cells

Autologous Stem cells provide new cells for the body as it grows and replaces the damaged or lost
cells.
[Learn more][85]

#### Platelet Rich Plasma

Plasma is a substance that plays a vital role in the healing of damaged tissues and stimulates the
growth of new, healthy cells.
[Learn more][86]

#### Amniotic/Placental Matrix

[Learn more][87]
The amniotic fluid or placental matrix is  used to treat damaged joints, control inflammation and
pain & more!

#### Prolotherapy

[Learn more][88]
Prolotherapy is a non-invasive regenerative medicine therapy that helps heal several ailments such
as arthritic joints and common sports injuries.

#### Peptide

[Learn more][89]
Peptides are a sequence of amino acids (proteins) that helps improve your body's own healing
abilities.

#### AccentPrime

Whether you want to get rid of stubborn fat in your midsection, or signs of aging on your face,
Accent Prime could be the non-invasive solution you’ve been looking for.
[Learn more][90]

#### Alma Accent Pixel RF

The Alma Accent Pixel RF in an advanced treatment platform that employs fractional ablation for skin
resurfacing.
[Learn more][91]

#### Botox

These injections are used to treat wrinkles and facial creases.
[Learn more][92]

#### Accufit™

Accufit™ is a third-generation electrical muscle stimulation platform that maximizes comprehensive
muscle activation.
[Learn more][93]

#### TED Hair Restoration

If you are one of the thousands of men and women who suffer from hair loss, Alma TED hair
restoration treatment is an excellent solution for getting back what you’ve lost.
[Learn more][94]

#### BeautiFill Fat Transfer

Revolutionary advances in medicine and technology have now made fat transfer more efficient,
effective, and convenient than ever before.
[Learn more][95]

#### Exosomes & Anti-Aging

Exosomes are extracellular vesicles, which are tiny fluid-filled sacs or nanoparticles that are
found in regenerative cells in the body.
[Learn more][96]

#### Nutraceuticals

Nutraceutical is a general term to describe any product derived from food sources that have extra
health benefits and the fundamental nutritional value found in foods.
[Learn more][97]

#### Peptide

Peptides are a sequences of amino acids (proteins) that helps improve your body's own healing
abilities.
[Learn more][98]

#### Accufit™

Accufit™ is a third-generation electrical muscle stimulation platform that maximizes comprehensive
muscle activation.
[Learn more][99]

#### Erectile Dysfunction

If ED is affecting a man's happiness or his relationship with his partner, it should be treated
earliest.
[Learn more][100]

#### Fat Transfer

Fat transfer is a surgical procedure where a doctor transfers fat from one part of your body to
another.
[Learn more][101]

#### Body Sculpting

Body sculpting refers to a wide range of medical procedures performed to shrink areas of the body
with stubborn body fat and reshape it to give a slimmer appearance.
[Learn more][102]

#### Fat Reduction

Fat removal procedures are used in cosmetic surgery with the purpose of removing unwanted tissues.
[Learn more][103]

#### Arthritis Pain

Arthritis is an inflammation of the joints caused by the reduction in the average amount of
cartilage.
[Learn more][104]

#### Steroid Injections

Steroid injections are synthetic drugs similar to cortisol, a hormone made in the body's adrenal
glands.
[Learn more][105]

#### PTSD

Post-Traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a mental health condition that is caused by either
witnessing or experiencing a scary incident.
[Learn more][106]

#### A2M

The alpha two macroglobulins (A2M) molecule injections are used to treat several problems of the
joints in the body.
[Learn more][107]

#### Shockwave Therapy

A non-invasive treatment that includes creating a series of low-energy acoustic wave pulsations
directly applied to the injured part of the patient's skin.
[Learn more][108]

#### PEMF

PEMF directs an electric field into the cartilage with the for achieving the maximum therapeutic
effect.
[Learn more][109]

Accufit™ is a third-generation electrical muscle stimulation platform that maximizes comprehensive
muscle activation.

## Head & Neck

Whether you’re suffering from acute or chronic pain, arthritis, or headaches, RestorePDX has an
innovative solution for returning your head and neck to a healthy, pain-free state.After precisely
diagnosing your specific problem, our clinicians will recommend the best treatments to relieve pain,
reduce inflammation, and accelerate the healing process so you can quickly get back to feeling your
best.

# Head & Neck Conditions We Treat:
* Cervical Herniated Disc
* Cervical Pinched Nerve
* Cervical Radiculitis
* Whiplash
* Neck Pain
* Headaches
* Occipital Neuralgia
* Cervical Stinger
* Intercostal Neuralgia
* Cervical Stenosis
* And More

## Shoulder

Whether caused by trauma, overuse, arthritis, or an inflammatory disorder, shoulder pain can have a
serious impact on your quality of life and overall body function. Using the latest diagnostic
technology, including dynamic ultrasound, our team will gain a precise view into the underlying
cause of your discomfort and prescribe innovative treatments to relieve your pain and promote
long-term healing.

# Shoulder Conditions We Treat:
* Shoulder Pain
* Shoulder Strain
* Calcific Tendonitis
* Bursitis
* Shoulder Arthritis
* Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder)
* Rotator Cuff Syndrome
* Rotator Cuff Tear
* AC (acromioclavicular) Joint Pain
* SC (sternoclavicular)
* Joint Pain
* Biceps Tendon tear/tendinosis
* And More

## Spine & Back

Discomfort in your upper, middle, and lower back can make everyday activities challenging and
prevent you from living life to the fullest. Nerve and muscular problems, poor posture, acute
injuries, and arthritis are all common causes, resulting in radiating pain, swelling and
inflammation, and irritated joints.By utilizing the latest diagnostic technology, our team can
quickly identify the root cause of your symptoms and administer precise, innovative treatments that
relieve pain and restore function.

# Spine & Back Conditions We Treat:
* Degenerative Disc Disease
* Herniated Disc
* Stenosis
* Facet Arthritis
* Pinched Nerve
* Lumbar Radiculitis
* Sciatica
* Sacroiliac Joint (SI) Dysfunction
* Intercostal Neuralgia
* Rib Pain
* And More

## Hand & Wrist

Everyday overuse, acute injuries, and age-related conditions like arthritis–all put increased strain
on the hands and wrists, resulting in joint and muscle pain, stiffness, and swelling.Beginning with
rigorous diagnostics, our team will work with you to uncover the precise source of your hand and
wrist symptoms, then recommend the most effective solutions to help you reduce pain, decrease
inflammation, and regain function.

# Hand & Wrist Conditions We Treat:
* Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
* Arthritis
* Neuritis
* Ganglion Cyst
* De Quervain’s Tenosynovitis
* Carpometacarpal Joint Arthritis
* Metacarpophalangeal Joint Arthritis
* Trigger Finger
* Thumb Arthritis
* Gout
* And More

## Head & Neck

Whether you’re suffering from acute or chronic pain, arthritis, or headaches, RestorePDX has an
innovative solution for returning your head and neck to a healthy, pain-free state.After precisely
diagnosing your specific problem, our clinicians will recommend the best treatments to relieve pain,
reduce inflammation, and accelerate the healing process so you can quickly get back to feeling your
best.

# Head & Neck Conditions We Treat:
* Cervical Herniated Disc
* Cervical Pinched Nerve
* Cervical Radiculitis
* Whiplash
* Neck Pain
* Headaches
* Occipital Neuralgia
* Cervical Stinger
* Intercostal Neuralgia
* Cervical Stenosis
* And More

## Shoulder

Whether caused by trauma, overuse, arthritis, or an inflammatory disorder, shoulder pain can have a
serious impact on your quality of life and overall body function. Using the latest diagnostic
technology, including dynamic ultrasound, our team will gain a precise view into the underlying
cause of your discomfort and prescribe innovative treatments to relieve your pain and promote
long-term healing.

# Shoulder Conditions We Treat:
* Shoulder Pain
* Shoulder Strain
* Calcific Tendonitis
* Bursitis
* Shoulder Arthritis
* Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder)
* Rotator Cuff Syndrome
* Rotator Cuff Tear
* AC (acromioclavicular) Joint Pain
* SC (sternoclavicular)
* Joint Pain
* Biceps Tendon tear/tendinosis
* And More

## Spine & Back

Discomfort in your upper, middle, and lower back can make everyday activities challenging and
prevent you from living life to the fullest. Nerve and muscular problems, poor posture, acute
injuries, and arthritis are all common causes, resulting in radiating pain, swelling and
inflammation, and irritated joints.By utilizing the latest diagnostic technology, our team can
quickly identify the root cause of your symptoms and administer precise, innovative treatments that
relieve pain and restore function.

# Spine & Back Conditions We Treat:
* Degenerative Disc Disease
* Herniated Disc
* Stenosis
* Facet Arthritis
* Pinched Nerve
* Lumbar Radiculitis
* Sciatica

* Intercostal Neuralgia
* Rib Pain
* And More

## Hand & Wrist

on the hands and wrists, resulting in joint and muscle pain, stiffness, and swelling.Beginning with
rigorous diagnostics, our team will work with you to uncover the precise source of your hand and
wrist symptoms, then recommend the most effective solutions to help you reduce pain, decrease
inflammation, and regain function.

* And More

Роскосмос Байконур (Казахстан)
Авиакосмическая промышленность
Изыскательские работы, проектирование, оформление разрешений на использование радиочастот, поставка
оборудования, монтаж и настройка, обучение персонала, сервисная, гарантийная и постгарантийная
поддержка.
][53] [
Лукойл. МЛСП им. Ю. Корчагина
Нефтегазовая промышленность
Специалистами компании ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ была запроектирована система связи, удовлетворяющая всем
вышеуказанным требованиям. Произведена поставка оборудования, монтаж, пуско-наладочные работы и ввод
в эксплуатацию системы профессиональной цифровой транкинговой радиосвязи на базе оборудования
Kenwood Nexedge. Произведена сертификация взрывобезопасного абонентского оборудования.
Распределенная система АФУ покрывает все зоны платформы, включая внутренние, труднодоступные для
проникновения радиосигнала, помещения.
][54] [
Авианосец "Адмирал Горшков" - "Викрамадитья"
Морской флот
Система бортовой связи стандарта NXDN на базе оборудования Kenwood Nexedge была разработана и
внедрена специалистами ЗАО «ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ» совместно со специалистами ОАО «Муромский радиозавод».
Установлены 8 цифровых ретрансляторов, система записи переговоров, произведена интеграция с бортовой
системой громкоговорящей связи и оповещения. Разработан абонентский комплект, состоящий из цифровой
радиостанции, спецчехла и шумозащищенной гарнитуры.
][55]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Find the Right Care, Right Away

#### Online Scheduling

Find a doctor and schedule your health care yourself with MyChart.

[Learn More][39]

#### Telehealth Scheduling

Find a Loyola Medicine doctor to speak to from your phone or computer today.

[Learn More][40]

#### Find a Doctor

Exceptional care begins with an exceptional physician. Find your provider here.

[Learn More][41]

#### Immediate Care Virtual Visits

Speak with a Loyola Medicine provider from the comfort of your own home.

[Learn More][42]
* *

### Pay My Bill

Loyola Medicine offers you an easy and secure method of paying your bills, including online and by
mail.

[Learn More* *][43]
* *

### Patient Portal

The MyChart patient portal makes it easy to stay connected to your health.

[Learn More* *][44]
* *

### Access Medical Records

We offer a variety of ways to access your health records including online and by phone.

[Learn More* *][45]

## Flexibility & Convenience

You want health care that's easy and convenient. We do, too. At Loyola Medicine, we offer a variety
of ways to access the care you need.

* [Find an urgent care][47]

* ###### News, Patient Stories and Blogs
  
  ## News, Blogs and Patient Stories
  
   
  
  #### When and How to Get a Second Opinion
  
   
  
  Getting a second opinion can increase your confidence in your diagnosis and treatment plans and
  ensure you choose a physician you have a comfortable rapport with. Some doctors also have access
  to emerging treatments through new clinical trials.
  
  [Read More][50]
* ###### News, Patient Stories and Blogs
  
  ## News, Blogs and Patient Stories 
  
  #### MacNeal Hospital Recognized for Excellence in Maternity Care By Blue Cross Blue Shield
  
  MacNeal Hospital is proud to be recognized by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Illinois with a Blue
  Distinction® Centers+ (BDC+) for Maternity Care designation, as part of the Blue Distinction
  Specialty Care program. To earn this designation, each facility must deliver quality care, safely
  and cost-effectively.
  
  [Read More][51]
* ###### News, Patient Stories and Blogs
  
  ## News, Blogs and Patient Stories
  
   
  
  #### Limb saving program helps patients with diabetes avoid amputation
  
   
  
  The team at Loyola Medicine's limb-saving program takes an integrated approach, combining the
  expertise of orthopaedic surgeons, podiatrists, endocrinologists and other specialists.
  
  [Read More][52]

### OUR SERVICES

### Regenerative Treatments: Boost your Immune Health, Get rid of Oxidative stress, and Reduced
### Inflammation.

### HYDROGEN THERAPY

The hydrogen molecule is the most lightweight gas; it can defuse freely across the membrane of our
cells, slipping through the gaps to make its way. Then the regeneration of the cell process occurs,
ensuring they are healthy and regulating correctly. The type of cells in our body consists of blood,
cancer, bone, brain, skin, etc.

Hydrogen Therapy affects all our body organs, tissues, and cells. So this extraordinary medicine
could be the key to the underlying cause of diabetes, hypertension, chronic illness, cancer and
major diseases. Make your life healthier now! Only here at MIMMO.

### CANCER TREATMENT ; MAGMA THERAPY

Far-infrared hyperthermia therapy (FIHT) is a proven, non-invasive treatment that uses far-infrared
radiation to raise body temperature and selectively target cancer cells. The heat damages tumor
cells, disrupts their repair mechanisms, and enhances the effectiveness of chemotherapy and
radiation. FIHT improves blood flow for better oxygen and drug delivery, stimulates the immune
system through heat shock protein activation, and promotes apoptosis (programmed cell death) in
cancer cells. This therapy is safe, effective, and an integrative approach to improving cancer
treatment outcomes.

### AUTOLOGOUS STEM CELL THERAPY

Autologous stem cell therapy is a definitive, non-invasive treatment that utilizes a patient’s own
stem cells to repair damaged tissues, regulate immune responses, and restore metabolic balance. This
therapy effectively improves insulin sensitivity and glucose regulation in diabetes, lowers blood
pressure and repairs vascular damage in hypertension, and alleviates chronic diseases and autoimmune
disorders by reducing inflammation and promoting tissue regeneration. It addresses the root causes
of metabolic conditions, providing lasting improvement in health and function.

### OTHER TREATMENTS

###### MITOCHONDRIAL NUTRIENT THERAPY

Revitalize your health with Mitochondrial Nutrient Therapy, a powerful blend of ALA, Vitamin C, B1,
and CoQ10 that restores cellular energy and promotes regeneration. Experience enhanced vitality and
recovery with our targeted, science-backed solution for optimal wellness.

###### PHOTOACTIVATED PLATELET RICH PLASMA

Manage your pain and heal with our PRP Drip or Targeted Injection, delivering your body’s own growth
factors directly where they’re needed most. Enhance regeneration, reduce inflammation, and restore
vitality with this advanced, natural therapy.

###### CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTOR - NATURAL KILLER CELL THERAPY

Harness the power of cutting-edge science with Chimeric Antigen Receptor-Natural Killer (CAR-NK)
Cell Therapy, designed to target and destroy cancer cells with precision. Boost your body’s healing
and regeneration with this innovative, personalized approach to transformative health.

### OUR SERVICES

### Regenerative Treatments: Boost your Immune Health, Get rid of Oxidative stress, and Reduced
### Inflammation.

### HYDROGEN THERAPY

The hydrogen molecule is the most lightweight gas; it can defuse freely across the membrane of our
cells, slipping through the gaps to make its way. Then the regeneration of the cell process occurs,
ensuring they are healthy and regulating correctly. The type of cells in our body consists of blood,
cancer, bone, brain, skin, etc.

Hydrogen Therapy affects all our body organs, tissues, and cells. So this extraordinary medicine
could be the key to the underlying cause of diabetes, hypertension, chronic illness, cancer and
major diseases. Make your life healthier now! Only here at MIMMO.

### CANCER TREATMENT ; MAGMA THERAPY

Far-infrared hyperthermia therapy (FIHT) is a proven, non-invasive treatment that uses far-infrared
radiation to raise body temperature and selectively target cancer cells. The heat damages tumor
cells, disrupts their repair mechanisms, and enhances the effectiveness of chemotherapy and
radiation. FIHT improves blood flow for better oxygen and drug delivery, stimulates the immune
system through heat shock protein activation, and promotes apoptosis (programmed cell death) in
cancer cells. This therapy is safe, effective, and an integrative approach to improving cancer
treatment outcomes.

### AUTOLOGOUS STEM CELL THERAPY

Autologous stem cell therapy is a definitive, non-invasive treatment that utilizes a patient’s own
stem cells to repair damaged tissues, regulate immune responses, and restore metabolic balance. This
therapy effectively improves insulin sensitivity and glucose regulation in diabetes, lowers blood
pressure and repairs vascular damage in hypertension, and alleviates chronic diseases and autoimmune
disorders by reducing inflammation and promoting tissue regeneration. It addresses the root causes
of metabolic conditions, providing lasting improvement in health and function.

### OTHER TREATMENTS

###### MITOCHONDRIAL NUTRIENT THERAPY

Revitalize your health with Mitochondrial Nutrient Therapy, a powerful blend of ALA, Vitamin C, B1,
and CoQ10 that restores cellular energy and promotes regeneration. Experience enhanced vitality and
recovery with our targeted, science-backed solution for optimal wellness.

###### PHOTOACTIVATED PLATELET RICH PLASMA

Manage your pain and heal with our PRP Drip or Targeted Injection, delivering your body’s own growth
factors directly where they’re needed most. Enhance regeneration, reduce inflammation, and restore
vitality with this advanced, natural therapy.

###### CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTOR - NATURAL KILLER CELL THERAPY

Harness the power of cutting-edge science with Chimeric Antigen Receptor-Natural Killer (CAR-NK)
Cell Therapy, designed to target and destroy cancer cells with precision. Boost your body’s healing
and regeneration with this innovative, personalized approach to transformative health.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# Evidence-Based Integrative Oncology and Complementary Cancer Therapies

Helping cancer patients and survivors combine conventional oncology with evidence-based nutrition,
lifestyle therapies, supplements, repurposed drugs, and survivorship strategies.

David Emerson is a long-term multiple myeloma survivor diagnosed in 1994. After four years of
conventional surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, and a stem cell transplant, his cancer relapsed. His
oncologist told him that nothing more could be done for him. David set out to learn about
alternative, complementary and integrative therapies to manage his cancer. 

David launched The Galen Foundation DBA PeopleBeatingCancer, a 501C3 non-profit, in 2004 with a
mission to support cancer patients and survivors with evidence-based complementary and integrative
therapies. David researches and writes about cancer daily while answering cancer patients' and
survivors' questions.

[ Click here to learn more about my story ][21]

## What Is Integrative Oncology?

Integrative oncology combines conventional cancer treatments with evidence-based complementary
therapies including nutrition, exercise, sleep optimization, stress reduction, supplements, and
selected repurposed medications.

## What Are Complementary Cancer Therapies?

Complementary cancer therapies are therapies used alongside conventional oncology treatment to help
improve quality of life, reduce side effects, and support survivorship.

## Are Repurposed Drugs Used in Cancer Therapy?

Repurposed drugs are medications originally developed for non-cancer conditions that researchers are
now studying for potential anti-cancer effects.

# Evidence-Based Integrative Oncology and Complementary Cancer Therapies

Helping cancer patients and survivors combine conventional oncology with evidence-based nutrition,
lifestyle therapies, supplements, repurposed drugs, and survivorship strategies.

David Emerson is a long-term multiple myeloma survivor diagnosed in 1994. After four years of
conventional surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, and a stem cell transplant, his cancer relapsed. His
oncologist told him that nothing more could be done for him. David set out to learn about
alternative, complementary and integrative therapies to manage his cancer. 

David launched The Galen Foundation DBA PeopleBeatingCancer, a 501C3 non-profit, in 2004 with a
mission to support cancer patients and survivors with evidence-based complementary and integrative
therapies. David researches and writes about cancer daily while answering cancer patients' and
survivors' questions.

[ Click here to learn more about my story ][21]

### Explore Evidence-Based Cancer Therapies Below:
* **[Complementary Therapies][22]**

* **[   Alternative Therapies][24]**
*   **[Repurposed Drugs as Cancer Therapy][25]**
*   [**Managing Therapy Side Effects**][26]

## What Is Integrative Oncology?

Integrative oncology combines conventional cancer treatments with evidence-based complementary
therapies including nutrition, exercise, sleep optimization, stress reduction, supplements, and
selected repurposed medications.

## What Are Complementary Cancer Therapies?

Complementary cancer therapies are therapies used alongside conventional oncology treatment to help
improve quality of life, reduce side effects, and support survivorship.

## Are Repurposed Drugs Used in Cancer Therapy?

Repurposed drugs are medications originally developed for non-cancer conditions that researchers are
now studying for potential anti-cancer effects.

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.
